purpose: Compare the merged task model, prior unweighted task model and rule task selector in complete official games.
seed_selection: System-random uint32 values from 1000000000 through 4294967295, distinct and excluded from recognized prior seed metadata and the fixed bootstrap seed.
seed_privacy: Seed values and a 256-bit salt remain local until the panel ends; public registration contains only their commitment and document hash.
panel: Four seed aliases, round2/market/full frozen teacher opponents, both seats, three task-policy arms: 72 games, 72 primary replays and one selected separate-process replay.
policy_scope: All three actor arms share the same frozen crop model and controller. teacher_task is a rule task selector, not the full teacher opponent.
metrics: Own and opponent net profit, margin, wins/draws/losses and score by opponent; paired merged minus unweighted and merged minus teacher_task.
gates: Only merged minus unweighted: per-pair own profit and margin >= -2000, per-seed/opponent two-seat averages >= -1000, and overall own profit/margin/score differences >= 0.
signal: Exploratory positive signal requires all gates and strictly positive overall own-profit and margin differences. Four complete-seed clusters, 10000 bootstrap resamples; no significance or automatic promotion.
resources: Single official Job at a time; three 4GiB available-memory checks before each, 2GiB sampled runtime floor, 900-second job limit, 128MiB per-game Python-write budget, 10GiB stage occupancy limit, 4GiB free-disk floor.
timing: The global deadline is checked around games and replay callbacks; a running Job can continue until it exits or its own 900-second limit, so the global deadline is not a hard real-time interrupt.
stopping: Any identity, budget, official game, replay, Job or cleanup failure stops the single attempt; no retry, replacement, additional game or partial-panel economic scoring.
observation: Official engine and same-engine replay only. Python stdout/stderr are discarded; native output handles are not independently verified. Memory and disk limits are sampled/software controls, not hard OS quotas.
privacy: Raw replay, private observations, logs, models, seed document and salt stay local during execution; only reviewed aggregates and commitments are published.
seed_history_limitation: Unavailable, deleted, external or unrecognized historical seed records cannot be excluded; a salted commitment is not a third-party timestamp or proof of operator blinding.
boundaries: No retraining, no policy/default Bot/rules/driver changes, no online submission and no automatic promotion.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and review; not WebChat.
